requiredFiles.role: Main OCR engine (API, OCR processing, worker management)

note: This manifest is read by CozyOS.OCR.getProviderStatus() consumers to check real vendor state before assuming OCR works — never claims installed:true without present binaries. See README.md and install.sh in this directory for how to install once network access is available. core/modules/ocr/plugins/tesseract-plugin.js already registers against CozyOS.OCR and will report itself honestly unavailable until these files exist and window.Tesseract loads.
